description: Report identifiers a model produced that turned out not to exist. HALLUX verifies each against its registry and records only absent ones as attestations in the public hallucination ledger, which is how names graduate to `phantom` and get watched for squatting. Requires an API key.

namespace.description: pkg.npm, pkg.pypi, pkg.crates, pkg.go, pkg.maven (group:artifact), pkg.nuget, pkg.rubygems, pkg.packagist (vendor/name), pkg.hex, pkg.pub, img.docker, repo.github (owner/repo), cite.doi

value.description: Exactly as written, e.g. requests, @types/node, github.com/spf13/cobra, org.slf4j:slf4j-api, 10.1038/nature12373

version.description: Optional exact version to verify. Models invent versions too.

name: hallux_report
